sanskrit_verse:
शौल्किकैः स्थानपालैर् वा नष्टापहृतम् आहृतम् ।
अर्वाक् संवत्सरात् स्वामी हरेत परतो नृपः ॥
transliteration: śaulkikaiḥ sthānapālair vā naṣṭāpahṛtam āhṛtam | arvāk saṃvatsarāt svāmī haret parato nṛpaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Property lost, stolen, or entrusted that has been recovered shall be reclaimed by its original owner within one year; beyond that time, it belongs to the king.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from ownership sustained in time
Causation is established through possession and temporal continuity
Capacity-based responsibility includes timely assertion of claim
Restoration logic prioritizes rightful alignment of property and consciousness
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of lawful boundaries
executable_legal_axioms: IF property is recovered AND time since loss ≤ 1 year THEN ownership reverts to original holder
IF property is recovered AND time since loss > 1 year THEN ownership transfers to sovereign authority
IF claimant demonstrates continuous awareness of loss THEN temporal limit may be reviewed under conscious intent protocols
IF no claim is made within prescribed period THEN possession becomes determinant of alignment with dharma
IF recovery occurs via third-party agency THEN agency must execute immediate notification protocol to prior owner
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, temporal thresholds serve as pramāṇa for determining rightful ownership. The court must assess not only legal possession but also the consciousness of the claimant—whether there was willful neglect or active pursuit. Sovereign authority assumes custodianship only after the failure of individual dharmic assertion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Ownership manifests sequentially through action, time, and awareness. If a person fails to assert their right within the natural cycle (saṃvatsara), it indicates a lapse in conscious alignment. This is not punished but realigned: the king, as the unifying consciousness of the realm, receives the property to maintain cosmic order without blame assigned.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process: notify prior owner immediately upon discovery
Establish timeline audit: verify exact date of loss and recovery
Facilitate reintegration dialogue between claimant and custodian
Align claimant's capacity through guided reflection on cause of loss
If transfer to king occurs, ensure public documentation and ritual offering to preserve energetic integrity
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from pure consciousness. Ownership aligns with time-bound dharmic assertion. Beyond the year, sovereignty assumes stewardship not as punishment but as restoration of universal balance. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
